Enablement of analytics-ready, high-quality laboratory data. What you should bring: Strong analytical and critical thinking. Technical proficiency in LIMS MD development, management and delievrables Understanding of analytical lab workflows and instruments. Excellent documentation and verbal communication Ability to work across global teams (IT, Quality, Lab Operations). jobs.description: Job Description We have an exciting opportunity for a physician-scientist to join our group as a Principal Scientist (Clinical Director) in Translational Medicine/Early Clinical Development in the Infectious Diseases Therapeutic Area . Translational Medicine at our Research Division is responsible for early clinical development of novel therapeutics, working in close collaboration with our discovery scientists and late-stage clinical researchers. The Infectious Diseases Therapeutic Area specifically focuses on translational and clinical development of anti-infectives, both for treatment and for prophylaxis indications. We are seeking a highly qualified individual for a position in our group. Candidates must have a strong background in basic and/or clinical translational research and a desire to work collaboratively with functional area partners across therapeutic areas and stages of development. Leadership of the early clinical development strategy for novel therapeutic programs from the preclinical stage through Phase 1 studies of safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics, to Phase 2 studies demonstrating Proof-of-Concept and enabling Phase 3 clinical trials. jobs.description: At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. Bristol Myers Squibb | European Tax Centre of Excellence Eligible for participation in the company’s annual bonus plan Family cover healthcare Attractive contributory pension scheme Hybrid working , 50% home / 50% office, giving you flexibility and balance 26 days holiday , plus bank holidays, plus festive shutdown Career and qualifications support , we invest in your growth Modern office with a range of on-site benefits, including on-site parking What if your tax expertise could do more than manage compliance — what if it could help change patients' lives? It might not be the first thing that comes to mind when you think about a tax role but at Bristol Myers Squibb , everything connects back to our purpose: transforming patients' lives through science. And the team that keeps our tax operations running with precision and integrity? They're part of that story too . We're looking for a Tax Manager to join our European Tax Centre of Excellence (COE) in Chester - a role where your technical skills meet real business influence and where the work you do every day genuinely matters. This is a tax role with real breadth. And real accountability for the outcomes across your markets. Here's what makes this different from a standard in-house tax position: you won't be a cog in a machine, processing the same returns year after year. You'll lead a portfolio of European markets - including the UK - working closely with local finance teams and external advisers to high-quality processes. You'll be the expert your finance colleagues come to when they need clarity, the professional who challenges external advisers, and the person who translates complex legislation into practical action to guide our stakeholders Here's what your role will actually look like: You'll run the full direct tax cycle for your own markets - leading corporate income tax return preparation with local external advisers, applying genuine technical challenge to their work, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks. You'll gain hands-on US GAAP experience - preparing and submitting US tax reporting including quarterly current and deferred tax provisions using TaxStream technology. This isn't something most in-house European tax roles offer, and it's a genuine differentiator for your CV. You'll work across the full breadth of tax governance - managing UK-specific requirements including Senior Accounting Officer (SAO), Tax Strategy publication, Corporate Criminal Offence (CCO), and the evolving world of Pillar Two . You'll be a genuine internal consultant - advising finance and business stakeholders on tax matters, explaining complex technical requirements in language they can act on, and building the kind of trusted relationships that make you indispensable. You'll shape how tax is done, not just do it - contributing to the COE's strategy around standardisation, automation, and continuous improvement. If you're curious about tax technology and smarter ways of working, this team is actively investing in that space. You'll stay ahead of legislative change - monitoring developments across your markets, analysing their impact, and proactively communicating what matters to the people who need to know. What do you actually gain from joining this team? Let's talk about what this role opens up for you - concretely. Breadth that most tax roles simply don't offer. European direct tax, US GAAP reporting, transfer pricing exposure, Pillar Two, UK tax governance - all under one role, in one team. Whether you're looking to deepen your specialism or broaden your horizons, this role does both. Access to leading external advisers. You won't be working in isolation. You'll collaborate with top-tier advisory firms, learn from their expertise, and develop the skills to challenge and manage them effectively - experience that builds your professional credibility significantly. Real stakeholder visibility. You'll regularly engage with senior finance leaders and business partners globally. That kind of cross-functional, international exposure builds commercial acumen and communication skills that go far beyond technical tax knowledge. Flexible, hybrid working from our modern office in Chester. A. With the 50% hybrid-working model, you’ll get to collaborate and build supportive working relationships with the large tax team, as well as others in the ECC, whilst creating a healthy work-life balance. The BMS mission as your backdrop. When you're filing that return, managing that audit, or navigating a piece of new legislation — you're doing it in support of a company that is genuinely working to help patients with serious diseases. That context changes how the work feels. You'll thrive in this role if… You're a qualified accountant and/or chartered tax adviser (CTA, ACA, ACCA or equivalent) with solid experience in tax accounting, tax provisioning, and statutory audit support. You've managed external advisers and you know how to review compliance deliverables with the right level of technical rigour. You communicate confidently - able to break down complex tax matters for finance colleagues and non-tax stakeholders alike, without losing accuracy. You're genuinely interested in tax technology, process improvement, and automation and you see them as opportunities, not threats. You're organised, ownership-driven, and comfortable managing multiple markets and deadlines simultaneously. You're fluent in English - additional European languages are a bonus, but not a requirement. Don't tick every single box? We'd still love to hear from you. jobs.description: Join the Clean Energy Revolution Become a Data Engineering, Senior Advisor at Southern California Edison (SCE) and build a better tomorrow. The senior advisor will develop programs using coding languages (i.e. Python, SQL) and/or low-code environments (i.e., Palantir Foundry) to create analyses and applications for stakeholders throughout Transmission & Distribution (T&D). Additionally, the candidate will perform data mining activities to derive insights, work with cloud OLAP systems (e.g., Snowflake), and keep abreast of new and current data engineering techniques. Keeps abreast of new and current data engineering, big data and data science techniques. Researches methods, techniques, and new practices; develops and promotes data engineering best practices, standards and guidelines. Provides governance and oversight of data assets, data environments and relevant data procedures, with the proactive planning and enforcement of data asset naming conventions. jobs.description:
About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role
Anthropic is seeking a Privacy Counsel to join our Legal team. You'll counsel on complex privacy issues and build the processes and programs that address privacy and data protection in a global context. This is a unique opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team, where you will have the chance to shape the company's privacy and data protection strategy and compliance program.
You will work at the intersection of novel legal questions, fast-moving product development, and a high-profile regulatory environment, partnering cross-functionally with Legal, Integrity & Compliance, Safeguards, Security, Policy, Research and Product.
Key responsibilities
Counsel product, research and engineering teams across the model and product lifecycles, applying laws written before frontier AI with clarity and fresh thinking
Translate complex technical architecture into clear, actionable risk advice
Deliver integrated guidance on safety, security and data protection
Lead privacy on Anthropic's most strategic deals and partnerships, opening creative paths for novel technologies
Negotiate privacy and data protection terms in enterprise, platform and partnership commercial agreements, including DPAs, BAAs, data sharing agreements and cross-border transfer terms
Lead privacy diligence on mergers and acquisitions, and support corporate governance
Collaborate closely with counsel and privacy colleagues on joint analysis, bringing competing views together into a single, well-reasoned position
Minimum qualifications
Hold a law degree (JD, LLB, or equivalent) and meet the local licensing requirements to work as in-house counsel where you'll be based
Hands-on experience advising a technology business (in-house or at a leading law firm) on privacy and data protection
Experience drafting and negotiating data protection agreements, such as DPAs, BAAs and data sharing agreements
Working knowledge of key global privacy laws, including those of the Americas, EEA and APAC
Ability to read and engage with technical documentation, such as system designs and architecture diagrams
Excellent legal writing, including clear, concise advice
Preferred qualifications
At least 8 years of privacy and data protection legal experience
Deep familiarity with software and model development and architecture
Proven ability to build privacy processes, playbooks and templates that scale with a fast-growing business
Direct engagement with privacy regulators, including providing briefings and responding to inquiries
Privacy and data protection work on mergers, acquisitions, and similar transactions
Background advising safety, security or trust and safety teams, including on privacy incidents and notification decisions
Role-specific policy: For this role, we expect all staff to be able to work from our San Francisco or New York office at least 3 days a week, though we encourage you to apply even if you might need some flexibility for an interim period of time.

Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit
anthropic.com/careers
directly for confirmed position openings.
How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
Come work with us!
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.

Chacune de ces décisions doit honorer ce à quoi le joueur a consenti, dans des dizaines de territoires dont les règles se contredisent et se réécrivent chaque année. Y parvenir à une telle échelle constitue un défi technique permanent. Ce défi relève de notre équipe Ads Privacy, qui porte la conformité en matière de renseignements personnels aux côtés des systèmes de modération publicitaire et de prévention de la fraude dont dépend la confiance accordée au réseau. Dans ce role, vous assumerez la pleine responsabilité de services critiques, de la conception jusqu'à la production. Votre terrain sera le chemin des requêtes, là où une réponse erronée se paie deux fois : en exposition juridique et en revenus. Java également bienvenu Expérience pratique de l'exploitation de services en infonuagique, avec Kubernetes et l'orchestration de conteneurs Connaissance des plateformes de diffusion en continu telles que Kafka et de la conception de systèmes événementiels Aisance sur des systèmes dont l'exactitude est vérifiée par des audits externes et dont les exigences se décident hors du développement Clarté de la communication écrite et verbale, et capacité à évoluer au sein d'une équipe multidisciplinaire Vous avez peut-être également Expérience en AdTech et une connaissance des cadres de l'IAB tels que le TCF Un parcours en protection des renseignements personnels, en confiance et sécurité, ou en détection de la fraude Compréhension éclairée des réglementations mondiales sur les données et la vie privée (RGPD, CCPA, et celles qui leur succéderont) Expérience avec SQL, NoSQL et les banques clé-valeur : Postgres, MongoDB, Redis Collaboration établie avec des équipes d'apprentissage machine ou de données pour porter modèles et pipelines en production Expérience en infrastructure as code et observabilité : Terraform, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry ________ The opportunity At Unity, we don't just help game developers build their games: we help them grow what they've built, and get their titles in front of the right players, through an ad system that makes billions of real-time decisions every day. Getting that right at this scale is a permanent engineering problem. It belongs to our Ads Privacy team, which owns privacy compliance alongside the creative moderation and fraud prevention systems that keep the network trustworthy. You will own privacy-critical services end to end, from design through production. You will work in the request path, where a wrong answer is both a legal exposure and a revenue event. About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role
Procurement Operations is the front door for buying at Anthropic. We sit inside Finance Operations and own the path from “I need to buy something” to a signed agreement, an accurate purchase order, and clean spend data at month-end.
We are hiring a Procurement Operations Business Partner to own that path for our research organizations and the special programs that spawn out of it. This portfolio behaves differently from the rest of the company in that it purchases goods and services from highly-specialized vendors and new programs regularly appear with real purchasing needs before any process exists for them. You will be the person who makes all of that feel simple to the researchers and program leads who depend on it, and reliable to the Finance stakeholders behind it. This is a high-volume role with an accounting core. You ensure every purchase in the portfolio is coded, dated, received, and accrued correctly, so research spend is right in the books every month. Expect a steady queue of requests, work orders, and change orders, and expect to be the person Accounting trusts on all of it.
We use Claude as part of our daily workflow and are looking for someone who wants to help define what an AI-native procurement operations function looks like, including how AI changes intake, document review, vendor coordination, and requester support.
Responsibilities
Own the purchasing path for R&D
Manage a high volume of purchase requests, work orders, and change orders each month across research teams and programs, keeping speed and accuracy high at the same time.
Serve as the primary procurement partner for Anthropic's research teams and special programs, guiding requesters from initial request to signed agreement and issued purchase order.
Review every purchase request in your portfolio for the things that matter downstream: the right vendor record and contracting entity, complete commercial documents, correct spend categorization and service dates, and the approvals the purchase actually needs.
Determine what each request requires before it can move, whether that is a statement of work, an order form, an amendment, a security or privacy review, or a third party risk assessment, and route it to the right reviewers the first time.
Launch and track contract review with Legal, keep it moving, and confirm the executed agreement supports the purchase order before it is issued.
Structure purchase orders so they match how the vendor bills (fixed fee, milestone, per-unit, or usage in arrears) and how Accounting needs to see the spend, with the right GL account, cost center, and service period on every line. Manage change orders, renewals, and closures over the life of each agreement.
Act as the dedicated operations partner for our research services vendor portfolio, where engagements are structured as master agreements with frequent work orders and scope changes, and where speed and documentation discipline both matter.
Handle the mechanics that come with hardware, equipment, and lab purchasing, including multi line quotes, lead times, shipping and receiving, and asset handoffs.
Financial completeness & accuracy
Code every purchase order correctly at creation, including GL account, spend category, cost center, and service period, and understand how each choice lands in the financials (expense vs. prepaid, capitalized equipment vs. operating spend).

카탈로그가 정확히 무엇인가요?- 쿠팡 웹과 앱에서 고객이 마주하는 상품명, 메인 이미지, 카테고리, 브랜드, 사이즈, 색상 등의 모든 정보를 아우르는 것이 바로 카탈로그입니다. 이는 고객이 검색하고 구매를 결정하는 데 결정적인 역할을 하므로, 카탈로그의 품질은 고객 경험과 구매 전환율에 직결됩니다. 인스펙터는 이 카탈로그의 품질을 엄격하게 유지하고 관리하는 핵심적인 역할을 담당합니다.
SQL, Excel은 얼마나 능숙해야하나요?- 엑셀은 VLOOKUP, COUNTIF, SUMIF 등 기본 함수를 활용해 데이터를 정리하고 간단한 현황을 파악할 수 있는 수준이면 충분하며, 복잡한 매크로나 VBA 능력이 필수는 아닙니다. SQL 역시 필수는 아니지만, 대량의 데이터를 다루는 업무에서 SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY 등 기초적인 쿼리를 활용할 수 있다면 업무 효율을 크게 높일 수 있습니다. 관련 지식이 부족하더라도 입사 후 사내 학습 기회를 통해 충분히 익히실 수 있습니다.
쿠팡에서의 마켓플레이스/3P는 무엇인가요?- 3P(Third-Party)는 쿠팡의 오픈마켓 방식으로, 외부 판매자가 직접 상품을 등록하고 판매하는 구조입니다. 쿠팡이 직접 매입해 판매하는 1P(First-Party)와 달리, 3P는 수십만 명의 셀러가 개별적으로 상품 정보를 등록하기 때문에 카탈로그의 품질이 일정하지 않기 쉽습니다. 인스펙터는 이러한 3P 카탈로그를 면밀히 검수하고 기준에 맞게 개선하는 역할을 맡습니다. 쿠팡 전체 거래액에서 3P가 차지하는 비중이 매우 높은 만큼, 이 검수 업무는 플랫폼의 신뢰도와 고객 경험을 좌우하는 핵심적인 역할을 합니다.
